segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, thanks for jumping on. I saw your note after the onboarding call yesterday, and yeah, I want to address the SSO item directly.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, because that was not a small item for us. We agreed before signature that SSO with our identity provider would be ready for the May 20 go-live. Then your implementation manager said she had no record of it and scoped us for password login only.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: You're right. We agreed to SSO by May 20 on the sales call on April 9, and I did not get that requirement to the implementation team. That's on me. They planned the kickoff from the standard package, so it landed as a surprise to them and to you, and I'm sorry.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: I appreciate you saying that, but we built our internal rollout around it. We have 84 managers invited to training on May 16, and our security team won't approve local passwords.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Understood. I talked with implementation this morning. They can still support the May 20 go-live if we get your metadata file by Friday, May 10, and they move the SSO configuration session to Monday at 2:00 Eastern.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works if it's actually confirmed. I don't want another call where the person doing the work is hearing it for the first time.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Fair. The implementation manager, Priya, is on the calendar invite now, and she'll own the Monday session. I'll also stay on for the first 10 minutes so we can make sure scope and dates are aligned.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. Does this change the contract or pricing? We signed for 120 seats at $18 per seat monthly, annual term.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: No change. SSO was included in the business plan tier you signed. Your first invoice will still be $25,920 for the year, net 30, starting at go-live.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Alright. Send me the updated implementation schedule today, and we're good.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. You'll have it by 3:00 Pacific, with the May 10 file deadline and Monday SSO session called out.
